scope: Exact PR source in isolated Node VM with synthetic API/DOM/storage; no live DB writes.

51 total; only first 50 rendered; no next-page or full-reference lookup control on doctor list.
Error-marked encounter retains diagnosis correction but removes all linked medication correction controls, contrary to SRS C-07.
Route remains B, but late A response overwrites body with patient A and A-targeting action buttons.
